title: fix(plugin-detail): lead the derived related table with the record name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBMmajhVvgaZ1CHUdWTUXtVx)_

Fixes #30033

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 关联列表在关系上没有声明列时,列取自子对象的 `highlightFields`,而它按设计从不含记录名称。现在用 `@object-ui/core` 现成的 `leadWithNameField`(ADR-0079:`nameField`,否则平台推导的名称字段)把名称放到第一列,高亮字段跟在后面;高亮里本来就有名称时只出现一次。没有 `highlightFields` 时的字段遍历同样让声明的名称领头。
- **为什么改:** 客户页的「商机」页签只看到金额、日期、概率,五行金额分不清是哪一单;唯一的链接是金额。「联系人」只剩邮箱,「活动」只剩类型。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 `RelatedList.tsx` 的派生列;作者在关系上声明的列原样不动,`highlightFields` 含义、高亮条和概览紧凑面板都没碰。名称列照样过 FLS、脱敏、外键剔除与全空剔除。`@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` 中 `effectiveColumns` 的 `declaredHighlights` 分支与字段遍历排序后的 `leadWithNameField` 三行;测试 `RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx` 末尾的 `objectstack#30033` describe。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx`,预期 `18 passed`;或在 example CRM 打开 Acme Corp 的「商机」页签,第一列是「商机名称」且可点开记录。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `effectiveColumns`, the two paths taken when the relation declares no columns:

- **`highlightFields` path.** The declared highlights now go through `leadWithNameField(objectSchema, declaredHighlights)` before the existing normalize, redaction, parent-key, FLS and empty gates. That helper is the one `@object-ui/core` already exports for exactly this (a synthesized list led by the record's name; the console's object list tabs and `InterfaceListPage` call it): the declared `nameField` (ADR-0079), else the type-aware derivation, moved to the front and listed once. It adds nothing when the name has no field definition, is `hidden`, or the derivation lands on a system-managed field. Because it runs before the gates, a name the reader may not read, a redacted one, or one that is the key back to the parent record is still dropped.
- **Field walk** (child declares no `highlightFields`). After the existing priority sort, the declared or derived name is moved to the front only if it is already among the surviving entries, so a field the walk filtered out never comes back. The name-ish ranking stays as the fallback order.
- **Authored columns** (`columns` on the relation) take the first branch, which is untouched: drawn exactly as declared.
- **Who reads this set.** The enlarged tab hands `object-grid` these keys, and the grid auto-links its first column to the record (pinned by `the auto-linked primary field gets the same anchor` in `plugin-grid`'s `ObjectGrid.linkCellAnchor.test.tsx`), so the name is now the row's link. The non-enlarged table (`data-table`, through `sortableColumns` / `tableColumns`) reads the same `effectiveColumns`, so it gets the same lead. Two more readers of `effectiveColumns[0]` and the key list move with it: the phone card gallery's `titleField` (now the name) and the CSV export's field list (now includes the name). The compact panels on 概览 return before any of these and are unchanged.
- **`titleFormat`.** `leadWithNameField` answers in field space: a legacy `titleFormat` is a render-only template with no column behind it, so a `titleFormat`-only object leads with the field the platform derives (pinned below), not the formatted title.
- **No spec key.** `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Clause-②: no`: no export, key or accepted value changes. Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx` (the enlarged face's shared harness), 7 cases:

- `highlightFields` that omit the name (`['account', 'amount', 'close_date', 'probability']`, as `crm_opportunity` declares): the grid's columns are `['name', 'amount', 'close_date', 'probability']` (the parent key `account` is dropped as before).
- A declared `nameField` that is not name-ish (`deal_title`) leads the same way.
- The name listed in `highlightFields` too: shown once, first.
- CONTROL: columns declared on the relation are drawn exactly as declared, no name added.
- The non-enlarged table reads the same set: `data-table` columns lead with `name`.
- No `highlightFields`: a declared name leads the field walk.
- `titleFormat` with no `nameField`: the column is the derived field (`code`), not the formatted title.

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- New file, fix in place: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 18 passed (18)`.
- Ablation 1, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replacing `leadWithNameField(objectSchema, declaredHighlights).map(normalizeColumn)` with `declaredHighlights.map(normalizeColumn)` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `edff8db6` to `eed0f11d`): 5 failed, 13 passed. Red: the highlight case (`expected [ 'amount', 'close_date', …(1) ]`), the non-name-ish `nameField`, the name-once case, the non-enlarged table, the `titleFormat` case. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, deleting the walk's `entries.unshift(...entries.splice(leadAt, 1))` line: 1 failed (`no highlightFields: a declared name leads the field walk too`), 17 passed. Restored the same way.
- The tests import `../RelatedList` from source, so no dist rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
- Whole `@object-ui/plugin-detail` suite under the lock, before the `main` merge: `Test Files 369 passed | 1 skipped (370)`, `Tests 3260 passed | 18 skipped (3278)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Browser check**, `examples/app-crm` dev boot (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`), Console from `ui/` source through vite, zh-CN, dev admin, Acme Corp. Before = `RelatedList.tsx` at `origin/main` `c23501b2b`, after = this branch; vite restarted between the legs and the served module checked for the change each time. Headers read off the page:

  | Tab | Before | After | Row link after |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | 商机 on Acme Corp | #, 金额, 预计成交日期, 赢单概率 (%), 操作 | #, 商机名称, 金额, 预计成交日期, 赢单概率 (%), 操作 | `Acme — Year-Ago Renewal` → the opportunity record |
  | 联系人 on Acme Corp | #, 邮箱, 操作 | #, 姓名, 邮箱, 操作 | `Ada Lovelace` → the contact record |
  | 活动 on an opportunity | #, 活动类型, 截止日期, 联系人, 客户, 操作 | #, 主题, 活动类型, 截止日期, 联系人, 客户, 操作 | `Product Demo — Globex New CRM` → the activity record |

  Before, the row link text was `75,000.00`, `ada@acme.example` and `会议`. 联系人 resolves through its declared `nameField: 'full_name'` (a formula); 商机 and 活动 declare none and lead with the derived `name` / `subject`. Screenshots (`before-*.png`, `after-*.png`, plus `*-readings.json`) are in the project's `ui-orders/30033-shots/` folder.
- **The non-enlarged face.** Measured in code: it reads the same `effectiveColumns`, so it is fixed in the same place and pinned above. Measured in the browser: on the example CRM's account and opportunity record pages the 概览 tab draws only the compact panels (zero tables on either page), so there is no body table there to photograph.
- **`maxColumns`.** The derived set is still capped at `maxColumns` (default 6), and the name now takes one of those slots, so a child with six or more highlights shows one highlight fewer.

## Verification

All on head `8408edf6` (this branch merged with `origin/main` `d79eecfe5`; the merge brought no change under `ui/packages/plugin-detail/` or core's `record-title.ts`), after a full `turbo run build` of the merged tree (119/119), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` (both programs; the test file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s file list): exit 0.
- `npx eslint src/RelatedList.tsx src/__tests__/RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx` from the package: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0, manifest intact (106 components).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 35 gates over the 3 changed paths; all 35 ran, all `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciles `35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- The `@object-ui/plugin-detail` vitest suite ran before the merge (above); the merge touched nothing it reads from source. The other families are this PR's CI check-runs.
